title: malus × floribunda f. scheideckeri
intro: Malus × floribunda f. scheideckeri, commonly known as Scheidecker's crabapple, is a hybrid species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Scheidecker's crabapple are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antiparasitic properties. The bioactive constituents of Scheidecker's crabapple may also contribute to its traditional uses in folk medicine, where it is valued for its ability to promote digestive health and reduce inflammation.
